words.example: The shares will appreciate if the dividend stays this high.
words.exampleZh: 股利維持這麼高的話，股價會增值。
words.notes: 表示增值時是不及物動詞。表示欣賞或感激時可接受詞。

words.example: A second phone call was of no avail; the order had already expired.
words.exampleZh: 再打一通電話也沒有用，委託已經過期。
words.notes: of no avail 和 to no avail 都是沒有用。多用在否定句。avail oneself of 是利用。

words.example: The fund went bankrupt and the accounts were frozen.
words.exampleZh: 基金破產，帳戶也被凍結。
words.notes: go bankrupt 是破產。

words.example: The fund bought bonds and left the shares for later.
words.exampleZh: 基金先買了債券，股票等以後再說。
words.notes: buy a bond 是買債券。也可指結合，如 solemn bond 鄭重的約束。

words.example: The bullion price moved less than the mining shares.
words.exampleZh: 金條價格的波動比礦業股小。
words.notes: gold bullion 是金條。

words.example: Traders turned bullish after the morning volume jumped.
words.exampleZh: 早盤成交量跳升後，交易員轉為看漲。
words.notes: bullish year 是看漲的一年。

words.example: Aside from the cost of the shares, the fee is small.
words.exampleZh: 除了股票成本，手續費不大。
words.notes: the cost of 後接名詞。作動詞可說 cost me three thousand dollars。

words.example: He definitely did not know which fund he had bought.
words.exampleZh: 他確實不知道自己買的是哪一支基金。

words.example: Currency depreciation made the foreign bond fund swing.
words.exampleZh: 貨幣貶值讓那檔國外債券基金上下擺。
words.notes: depreciation cost 是折舊費用。

words.example: A surprise rate hike can depress share prices in a day.
words.exampleZh: 意外升息可以在一天內壓低股價。
words.notes: depressed 是蕭條的，或情緒低落的。

words.example: The screen of red prices left him with a despairing look.
words.exampleZh: 滿屏下跌的價格讓他一臉絕望。
words.notes: thoroughly despairing 是徹底絕望。

words.example: The ministry will devalue the currency before the bond sale.
words.exampleZh: 債券標售前，主管機關會讓貨幣貶值。

words.example: Another down day will discourage the new investors.
words.exampleZh: 再跌一天，就會讓新投資人卻步。
words.notes: discourage sb from 是勸某人不要做。

words.example: Shareholders want to know what dividend they will receive.
words.exampleZh: 股東想知道自己會拿到多少股利。
words.notes: cash dividend 是現金股利。

words.example: The price did not drop, but the volume almost disappeared.
words.exampleZh: 價格沒有下跌，成交量卻幾乎消失。
words.notes: drop off 是減少，或順路放下。

words.example: The economic report made the bond market jumpy.
words.exampleZh: 這份經濟報告讓債市緊張起來。
words.notes: economic 指經濟層面。省錢要用 economical。

words.example: Poor timing will indebt the fund to its brokers.
words.exampleZh: 時機不好會讓這檔基金欠下券商的錢。
words.notes: 常用過去分詞：be indebted to 是受惠於，或欠某人。

words.example: Bond prices usually fall when inflation jumps.
words.exampleZh: 通膨一跳，債券價格通常會跌。
words.notes: inflation rate 是通膨率。

words.example: Only half of the cash is investable; the rest covers withdrawals.
words.exampleZh: 只有一半現金可以拿去投資，其餘要應付提領。
words.notes: investable asset 是可投資資產。

words.example: The failed investment wiped out two years of savings.
words.exampleZh: 這筆失敗的投資吃掉了兩年的存款。
words.notes: make an investment 是進行投資。

words.example: A cautious investor would not chase this rally.
words.exampleZh: 謹慎的投資人不會去追這波上漲。
words.notes: individual investor 是散戶。

words.example: A layman should not read a futures screen as if it were a price tag.
words.exampleZh: 外行不該把期貨報價看成標價。

words.example: His knowledge of options is limited to the name.
words.exampleZh: 他對選擇權的了解只停留在名稱。
words.notes: limited company 是有限公司。

words.example: Treating shares like a lottery is how the account was emptied.
words.exampleZh: 把股票當彩券買，帳戶就是這樣被掏空的。
words.notes: lottery ticket 是彩券。

words.example: The trade looked lucrative until the fee was counted.
words.exampleZh: 把手續費算進去之前，這筆交易看起來很好賺。

words.example: The lure of a quick double made him ignore the debt.
words.exampleZh: 快速翻倍的誘惑讓他忽略了債務。
words.notes: the lure of 是……的誘惑。作動詞是引誘。

words.example: One lucky listing made her a millionaire on paper.
words.exampleZh: 一次幸運的掛牌讓她帳面上成了百萬富翁。
words.notes: overnight millionaire 是暴發戶。

words.example: The new monetary policy lifted short-term rates.
words.exampleZh: 新的貨幣政策拉高了短期利率。
words.notes: monetary system 是貨幣制度。

words.example: Two funds monopolize trading in that thin stock.
words.exampleZh: 兩檔基金壟斷了那支冷門股的交易。
words.notes: 把某一檔股票或某個市場的交易佔為己有。

words.example: Most of the fund is in national bonds, not foreign shares.
words.exampleZh: 這檔基金大部分是國內債券，不是外國股票。
words.notes: national 在考試裡常作定語，如 national income。

words.example: The newly issued bond is harder to sell than the old one.
words.exampleZh: 新發行的債券比舊的更難賣。
words.notes: newly 是時間副詞，多放在分詞前面。

words.example: Few brokers stay optimistic about this sector.
words.exampleZh: 很少有經紀人對這個產業還保持樂觀。
words.notes: be optimistic about 是對……樂觀。

words.example: An oral promise to buy the shares is not an order.
words.exampleZh: 口頭答應要買那些股票，不算下單。
words.notes: oral agreement 是口頭協議。oral examination 是口試。

words.example: Overseas holdings must be reported on the same form.
words.exampleZh: 海外持股必須填在同一張表上。
words.notes: overseas student 是留學生。overseas trade 是海外貿易。

words.example: A sudden halt can panic traders who borrowed to buy.
words.exampleZh: 突然停牌會讓借錢買進的交易員恐慌。
words.notes: cause panic 是引起恐慌。

words.example: Every participant in the placement received the same letter.
words.exampleZh: 這次募資的每位參與者都收到同一封信。
words.notes: 參加某次交易、會議或計畫的人。

words.example: Some clients perceive the fee as a hidden charge.
words.exampleZh: 有些客戶把這筆費用看成隱藏收費。
words.notes: perceive that，或 perceive sb do sth。

words.example: The fund is not in peril of a forced sale today.
words.exampleZh: 這檔基金今天沒有被迫出售的危險。
words.notes: in peril 是處於危險。at the peril of 是冒著……的危險。

words.example: A long flat price is a normal phenomenon in this stock.
words.exampleZh: 這支股票長時間橫盤是正常現象。
words.notes: 複數是 phenomena，不是在字尾加 s。

words.example: It is a pity the warrant expired on a Friday.
words.exampleZh: 權證在星期五到期，真可惜。
words.notes: It's a pity that 是可惜的是。作「同情」時也可接 for。

words.example: He sold only a portion of the holding.
words.exampleZh: 他只賣掉持股的一部分。
words.notes: portion 是可數名詞。

words.example: A small proportion of clients trade every day.
words.exampleZh: 只有一小部分客戶每天交易。
words.notes: a proportion of 是其中一部分。

words.example: The first month will prove whether the hedge works.
words.exampleZh: 第一個月就會證明這道避險有沒有用。
words.notes: prove that，或 prove 後面接形容詞。過去分詞 proven 和 proved 都可以。

words.example: Prices rebound whenever the broker steps in to buy.
words.exampleZh: 只要那家券商進場買，價格就反彈。
words.notes: rebound in prices 是價格回升。

words.example: The recession made even patient investors sell.
words.exampleZh: 經濟衰退讓連有耐心的投資人也賣出。
words.notes: economic recession 是經濟衰退。

words.example: The letter will reveal which account paid for the shares.
words.exampleZh: 這封信會揭露是哪個帳戶付的股票款。
words.notes: reveal sth to sb 是向某人揭露。

words.example: A revival in exports lifted the related shares.
words.exampleZh: 出口復甦拉抬了相關股票。

words.example: The risk in this warrant is higher than in the shares.
words.exampleZh: 這張權證的風險比股票高。
words.notes: run a risk 是冒險。assume the risk 是承擔風險。

words.example: The desk only handles listed securities.
words.exampleZh: 這個窗口只處理上市證券。
words.notes: 複數形式就是字頭。securities market 是證券市場。也可指擔保。

words.example: The shakeout cleared the traders who had borrowed the most.
words.exampleZh: 這次暴跌清掉了借最多錢的交易員。
words.notes: 行情劇烈下跌後，槓桿過高的人被清出市場。

words.example: She sold the shares before the meeting started.
words.exampleZh: 她在會議開始前把股份賣掉了。
words.notes: buy shares 是買股票。作動詞是分享。

words.example: Trading stayed sluggish until the last hour.
words.exampleZh: 交易一直冷清，直到最後一個小時。

words.example: Nobody expected the slump to last past lunch.
words.exampleZh: 沒有人料到暴跌會延續到中午以後。

words.example: A smart order waits for the spread to narrow.
words.exampleZh: 聰明的下單會等買賣價差變窄。
words.notes: smart 也可指衣著時髦。

words.example: He began to speculate with money he could not lose.
words.exampleZh: 他開始拿輸不起的錢去投機。
words.notes: speculate in 是投機於某類商品。speculate 也可指推測。

words.example: A splendid gain on paper is useless if you cannot sell.
words.exampleZh: 帳面賺得再漂亮，賣不掉也沒用。
words.notes: splendid 多用於肯定句。

words.example: The bid stayed steady even while the index fell.
words.exampleZh: 大盤下跌時，這個買價仍然穩定。

words.example: The company's stock fell even though sales rose.
words.exampleZh: 公司的股票跌了，雖然銷售上升。
words.notes: fall in stocks 是股價下跌。stock 也可指存貨。

words.example: Ask a stockbroker before you place an order that large.
words.exampleZh: 下那麼大的單之前，先問股票經紀人。
words.notes: 替客戶買賣股票的人。

words.example: Stockholders will vote on the new share issue Friday.
words.exampleZh: 股東星期五會表決這次新股發行。
words.notes: dominant stockholder 是控股股東。

words.example: The fund's strength is its pile of short-term bonds.
words.exampleZh: 這檔基金的優勢是手上的短期債券。
words.notes: economic strength 是經濟實力。

words.example: The loss sits in a subsidiary, not in the parent accounts.
words.exampleZh: 虧損記在子公司，不在母公司的帳上。

words.example: Even with investor support, the price could not hold.
words.exampleZh: 即使有投資人撐著，價格還是守不住。
words.notes: support 可接名詞。support in 是在某方面支持。

words.example: I sympathize with anyone who bought at the peak.
words.exampleZh: 我同情任何在高點買進的人。
words.notes: sympathize with 後面接受同情的人。

words.example: The takeover bid arrived before the market opened.
words.exampleZh: 收購出價在開盤前送到。
words.notes: takeover offer 是收購要約。

words.example: The chairman's theatrical warning scared the smaller holders.
words.exampleZh: 董事長誇張的警告嚇到了小股東。

words.example: The shares sit in a trust until she turns thirty.
words.exampleZh: 那些股份放在信託裡，直到她三十歲。
words.notes: trust 作「信任」時多不可數。have trust in 是信任。

words.example: The trustee refused to release the shares early.
words.exampleZh: 受託人拒絕提前放出那些股份。

words.example: The rating change is unfavorable to anyone holding the bond.
words.exampleZh: 評等調整對持有這檔債券的人不利。
words.notes: unfavorable to 是對……不利。

words.example: A quick recovery is unlikely while volume stays this thin.
words.exampleZh: 成交量這麼稀薄時，不大可能很快回升。
words.notes: be unlikely to 是不大可能做某事。

words.example: They will not venture more cash into that startup.
words.exampleZh: 他們不會再把更多現金投進那家新創公司。
words.notes: venture on 是冒險做某事。joint venture 是合資事業。

words.example: Low volatility does not mean the shares are safe.
words.exampleZh: 波動低不代表這些股票就安全。
words.notes: price volatility 是價格波動。化學上 volatility 也可指揮發性。
